## Why This Is Asked
This question validates private deployment awareness, data residency, and practical integration of OpenAI with basic safeguards in a beginner-friendly setup.

## Key Concepts
- Private endpoints for Azure OpenAI Service
- VNet isolation and egress controls
- Retrieval augmentation with Azure Cognitive Search
- Lightweight redaction before forwarding to OpenAI

## Code Example
```javascript
// Minimal redaction function
function redact(input){
  const patterns = [/SSN:\s*\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}/g, /API_KEY\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+/g];
  return input
    .replace(patterns[0], 'SSN=REDACTED')
    .replace(patterns[1], 'API_KEY=REDACTED');
}
```
